title: States page
summary: The loading, empty, error and forbidden content a page shows in place of its own, one at a time: the page-type building block for "nothing to show yet".

props.name: state
props.description: Which content shows. ready reveals the slotted content and hides the rest; every other value hides the slotted content and draws the matching built-in state (a labelled skeleton for loading, pk-empty-state for empty and forbidden, a danger pk-alert for error).

props.name: heading
props.description: Heading for empty, error or forbidden. A sensible default is used when empty ("Nothing here yet", "Something went wrong", "Not allowed").

props.name: description
props.description: Explanation for empty, error or forbidden.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the loading skeleton (defaults to "Loading").

slots.description: The page's own content, shown only in the ready state.

slots.name: drawn
slots.description: Internal: the drawn loading/empty/error/forbidden content. A light-DOM child this element creates and self-assigns here (never a shadow-root child), so the SDK's on-demand loader can see and upgrade it.

events.name: pk-retry
events.description: The error state's Retry action was activated. The host decides what happens (reload the data, set state back to loading); this element never retries by itself.

parts.name: content
parts.description: Wraps the default slot; hidden outside the ready state.

writes.why: A light-DOM element this element creates and owns itself (never a host-given node), self-assigned to its own drawn slot so the SDK's on-demand loader can see and upgrade it (a shadow-root child would be invisible to it).

a11y: The error alert and empty/forbidden states use pk-alert and pk-empty-state's own roles and announcements; nothing here is re-implemented.

examples.title: Loading, then the real content
examples.html: The order list goes here once it loads.

examples.title: Error, with Retry
examples.html: <pk-states-page state="error" heading="Could not load orders" description="The request timed out."></pk-states-page>

examples.title: Empty
examples.html: <pk-states-page state="empty" heading="No orders yet" description="Orders appear here once a customer checks out."></pk-states-page>
